scientific_integrity: The analytic reduction from all inscribed simplices to vertex simplices and the parameter transfer are separately proved; exhaustive finite arithmetic certifies the remaining finite root configurations, not arbitrary real configurations directly.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the specified radial two-orbit type-F4 root hull. The sharp finite determinant bound and optimizer incidence depend on an exhaustive, reproducible, exact integer enumeration supplied with the result. Classical root-system tables not retrievable in full may contain overlapping equal-radius results. Independent scientific review has not been performed.
title: Sharp four-simplex transition in the scaled type-\(F_4\) root hull
